scope: Docker World with MariaDB/Redis Compose dependencies; 100 movement-enabled WebSocket clients

joinPhase.scope: From client-load start through 100-client convergence and capacity+1 rejection
joinPhase.tickMaxScope: Actuator timer max reported at phase end; may include server startup

steadyState.tickMaxScope: Actuator timer max at phase end; cumulative since packaged World startup
steadyState.tickP95Scope: Dedicated p95 gauge from a 3 x 10-second rolling histogram, read after the measured movement phase
